description: Change the SELinux security context of each FILE to CONTEXT.

option.name: --dereference
tip: Affect the referent of each symbolic link (this is the default), rather than the symbolic link itself

option.name: --no-dereference
tip: Affect symbolic links instead of any referenced file

option.name: --range
tip: Set range RANGE in the target security context

option.name: --recursive
tip: Operate on files and directories recursively

option.name: --reference
tip: Use security context of RFILE, rather than specifying a CONTEXT value

option.name: --role
tip: Set role ROLE in the target security context

option.name: --type
tip: Set type TYPE in the target security context

option.name: --user
tip: Set user USER in the target security context

option.name: --verbose
tip: Output a diagnostic for every file processed

option.name: -H
tip: If a command line argument is a symbolic link to a directory, traverse it. Only valid when -R is specified

option.name: -L
tip: Traverse every symbolic link to a directory encountered. Only valid when -R is specified

option.name: -P
tip: Do not traverse any symbolic links (default). Only valid when -R is specified
